claim_scope: Evidence-informed WHOLE Eldonia ludwigi living-reconstruction teaching visualization. Complete soft animal retained, not isolated disc shell. Nominal150mm disc diameter is illustrative within museum reported maximum, not specimen replica. Internal gut shown as a flush color-coded dorsal anatomical projection, explicitly NOT natural skin coloration, transparency assertion, exposed organ or raised external hose. Mouth and anus physically ventral and off-centre. Body thickness, exact posture, colors and fine branch geometry inferred. Cambroernid/stem-ambulacrarian affinity is a supported phylogenetic hypothesis, not settled extant phylum; benthic versus pelagic ecology and mobility remain uncertain. No claim of settled jellyfish-like free-swimming ecology.
